status: registered before new mapping outcomes; retrospective development diagnostic
style_reference: previous_belief_shape_personal_history; frozen training state table plus strictly earlier legal positive-weight raw Q9 histories; fixed personal prior mass 3
no_history: missing-state training table, otherwise training population; no current/future answer used
mapping: finer class retains original probabilities; other classes use largest-remainder allocation of 100/grid integer units, grids 5 and 10; exact fractional ties use original bin order; no forced deflation zero or nonzero-bin count
style_assignment: one hash-derived uniform per respondent and seed, shared across target months, model arms and generation repeats; categorical probabilities may evolve from earlier history

permutation.strata: target month; all 12 roster members, including any later excluded by evaluation quality; assigned classes shuffled, preserving full-roster class counts; fixed points allowed; same permutation shared across model arms and repeats

common_eligibility: real current and calendar-previous Q9 plus all three model arms and all three possible mapping classes must be scorable using the frozen scorer; exclude once, identically for every condition; report exclusions and mapping-only failures
weighting: unweighted selected 12-person cohorts; month x generation-repeat cells equally weighted; not national headline evaluation; four disconnected months do not support a long continuous model trajectory
quantiles: project left-inverse empirical CDF for all medians and IQRs; different from interpolated IQR in Kimi small-sample description; no selection between conventions

bootstrap.unit: whole observed respondent across all target months and both generation repeats; renormalize each month; comparisons personal vs native and personal vs mean of 50 permutation metric results; primary style seed only, conditional on fixed assignments, histories and mapping; not a permutation p-value or nationwide interval

seed_sensitivity: report every registered seed and aggregate ranges, no best seed selection; assignment/permutation variability separate from respondent bootstrap uncertainty
decision: no new API automatically follows; a lower center error alone or increased IQR alone is insufficient. Report whether both cross-section and update distributions improve and whether intervals support differences. If width remains compressed, retain as local measurement diagnostic only.
exposure: These four months and older uniform rounding outcomes were already examined; this is not an unseen project test or a causal identification of reporting style.
